changelog:
@Announcements Ping Retro Rewind v6.12.3 has been released! This update IS required to continue to play online!

# 🙉 Character Updates 🙉
```- Readded Raincoat Baby Daisy by Poobah.
- Added a minimap icon for Captain Toad.
- Updated the character Spike to it's latest release.
- Renamed a few characters, as well as correcting a few author credits.```

# 🏁 Gameplay Updates 🏁
```- Players will not be able to get balloons removed from teammate's items in team Royale.
- Added the ability for ultra shortcuts to be performed in offline modes.```

# ⚙️ Other Updates ⚙️ 
```- Added a new code to mute Rosalina's luma sounds.
- Added new special badges for online, thanks to Fenixien for making the new badges.
- Added a new menu for user's with custom online badges to be able to toggle their badge.
- Moved around and reorganized specific settings, which may vary depending on if being accessed online or offline menus.
- Ghosts will now save the selected custom character to the ghost RKG.
- Refactored matchmaking logic to try and improve matchmaking quality.```

# 🐜 Bug Fixes 🐜 
```- Fixed multiple issues with different gamemodes in local multiplayer.
- Fixed an issue where swapping character costumes could result in a frame t-pose, thanks to Yves for fixing this issue.
- Fixed an issue where the blue shell 15 second cooldown wasn't applying.
- Fixed an issue where player's can select custom/retro tracks while playing in the regular vs mode.
- Fixed an issue where the in game VR leaderboard would fail to load.
- Fixed an issue with battle mode where squishing someone with a mega mushroom would take the attacker's balloon away instead.
- Other minor bugfixes and improvements.```

Full Download: https://update.rwfc.net/RetroRewind/zip/RetroRewind.zip
